title: HNMM-TRaC – Clinical and Molecular Analysis of Head and Neck Mucosal Melanoma: Clinical and Molecular Characterization, Treatment Response, and Prognostic Markers—A Real-World Data Analysis
summary: This study examines people with a rare head and neck melanoma and evaluates real-life treatment courses. It looks at how well therapies work, how the disease progresses, and which side effects occur. It also explores which personal or disease-related factors may influence treatment outcomes. The goal is to improve future therapies and better tailor them to individual patients.

interventions.name: Analysis of patients diagnosed with mucosal melanoma of the head and neck, including the oral cavity, nasal cavity, and pharynx, based on available real-world data within the ADOReg registry.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed mucosal melanoma of the head and neck.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients with cutaneous, oculo-mucosal, or urogenitally localized mucosal melanoma, as well as those with incomplete or missing minimum datasets, will be excluded from the analysis.
